summary: Implemented `feedback-request-batch-upload`: added FeedbackBatch/Feedback Prisma models and migration, replaced the protected Feedback Request placeholder with a .xlsx upload form, added server-side workbook parsing/validation for required columns and `type=purchase`, created transactional batch/feedback row persistence with unique link identifiers, and added mockable Gmail-based feedback request email delivery with row-level sent/failed tracking.
